references.text: Previous instruction that onyx stones and setting stones were to be gathered for the ephod and the breastpiece.
Description of how the onyx stones were to be used on the ephod, with the names of the sons of Israel engraved upon them.
Detailed description of the twelve precious stones to be set in the breastpiece (חֹשֶׁן).
Fulfillment of the instruction: the onyx stones were made and placed on the ephod.
Fulfillment of the instruction: the precious stones were set into the breastpiece.
David also gathered onyx stones and setting stones for the temple, similar to the gift given by the leaders here.
The chiefs (נְשִׂיאֵי) of Israel also brought gifts for the tabernacle at its dedication.
This reference shows the direct narrative link between the instruction on what was to be brought (35:9) and the actual delivery from the leaders (35:27).
